div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Appointment System · 17 lifecycles

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Order lifecycle
pending → paid → confirmed → serving
→ completed → reviewed
pending/paid → cancelled
paid → refunding → refunded
tech locked 3 min · refund: manager→finance 2 levels

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Group-buy activity
ongoing → joined → group_paid
ongoing → full → closed
joined → cancelled (not formed)
Redis NX anti-oversell · price = original × discount_percent

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Flash sale
published → ongoing → sold_out / ended
ongoing → seckill_order
row lock stock-1 · cancel does not restore stock

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Spend-and-save
draft → published → used / ended
post-coupon ≥ threshold auto-discount, max · group-buy/flash skipped

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Payment callback
payment record → unified order → frontend initiates
→ WeChat verify → status paid → notify both sides

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Member card
active → used_up (sessions used up)
active → expired (monthly/VIP expiry)
active ⇄ frozen (violation freeze/unfreeze)

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Coupon
draft → published → claimed
claimed → used / expired
published → ended (stock gone/expired)

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Coupon transfer
available → transferred (8-char code, valid 7 days)
→ claimed / expired (lazy check restores coupon)
Redis NX + row lock anti-double-spend · one transfer only

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Points expiry
earned (expires_at = now + 365 days)
→ used / expired
PointsExpiryTimer every 60s · three-layer idempotency

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Balance/points transfer
validating → locked → completed / failed
duplicate client_token → idempotent
Redis NX 30s + both-side row locks (user_id ascending)

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
E-invoice
pending → issued (invoice_no + issued_at)
pending → rejected (reject_reason)
uk_order_type prevents duplicates, amount server-side

div.style: color: rgb(80, 7, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Technician onboarding
applied → approved → active
applied → rejected → applied (resubmit)
active ⇄ suspended · active → banned

div.style: color: rgb(80, 7, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Token auth
issued → active → refreshed → active
active → blacklisted (logout/password/concurrency > 3)
active → expired (unused for 7 days)

div.style: color: rgb(80, 7, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Account cancellation
active → requested (balance/open orders/tickets block 422)
requested → active (cancel request)
requested → closing (confirmed after 72h)
anonymizes phone/nickname + status=0

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Technician withdrawal
pending → approved → processing → completed (T+1 WeChat balance)
pending → rejected → returned
manager review → finance confirm, two levels

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Support ticket
open ⇄ open (admin replies append)
open → closed (own ticket/open only, rating 1-5)

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Lucky wheel
on → spun → points / balance / coupon / lose
Redis NX + row lock + random_int weights + client_token idempotency

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Repeat-customer reward
completed → checked → pending → settled / none
same technician within 30 days · idempotent on order_id+type
